episodes.title: She Escaped a Polygamist Cult at 11 — Now She's a Self-Made Millionaire
episodes.description:
Maeli Nelson was raised in a polygamist cult with no formal education — until her mother stood up and said no more. This is her story of escape, rebuilding from nothing, and becoming a self-made millionaire.

On this episode of the Thrive Hive Show, Azaya & Revan sit down with Maeli Nelson — real estate entrepreneur, wealth educator, and founder of the 900-member women's collective Creating Her Empire — for a raw conversation about escaping a polygamist cult at age 11 and building an entirely different life from scratch.

Maeli shares what it was like growing up with no formal education, being pre-ordained to marry as a child, and the turning point when her mother refused to accept a "revelation" that would have changed both their lives. She opens up about the night they left with nothing, meeting her own siblings for the first time at her father's funeral, and how she went from a trailer park to selling million-dollar homes. The conversation moves into her perspective on financial education, entrepreneurship, and the difference between the beliefs we inherit and the ones we consciously choose — plus a candid conversation about divine feminine and masculine dynamics in relationships.

This episode includes discussion of childhood trauma, coercive control, and personal financial philosophy, shared in the spirit of Thrive Hive's mission: heal, grow, thrive.
